# Yahoo News

> > Yahoo News delivers breaking news, live updates, and comprehensive coverage across politics, health, science, and world events with original reporting and curated content.

Yahoo News is a major news aggregation and original content platform covering US politics, international affairs, health, science, and lifestyle topics. The site offers newsletters, breaking news alerts, and original investigative reporting alongside curated stories from partner outlets.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- US Politics
- World News
- Health & Medical
- Science & Space
- Climate Change
- Criminal Justice
- FBI
- Iran
- Donald Trump
- Newsletters
- Original Content
- Live Updates
- News Aggregation
- International Affairs

## Core News Sections

- [Yahoo News Homepage](https://news.yahoo.com): Main homepage with breaking news, top stories and live updates
- [US News](https://news.yahoo.com/us): US news section with breaking stories, politics and local coverage
- [Politics](https://news.yahoo.com/politics): Political news coverage including Trump administration and Senate updates
- [World News](https://news.yahoo.com/world): International news coverage from Middle East, Saudi Arabia and global events

## Health & Science Coverage

- [Health News](https://news.yahoo.com/health): Health news on insurance, obesity drugs, air pollution and medical policy
- [Science News](https://news.yahoo.com/science): Science news on NASA Artemis, space exploration and astronomy coverage
- [Coronavirus Coverage](https://news.yahoo.com/coronavirus): COVID-19 news, vaccine updates and pandemic coverage with fact-checking
- [Climate Change](https://news.yahoo.com/tagged/climate-change): Climate change news covering extreme weather, flooding and environmental policy

## Breaking News & Investigations

- [Iran-US Energy Crisis](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/trump-threatens-destroy-irans-largest-052051938.html): Iran-US tensions escalate as oil and gas prices surge over Qatar LNG facility
- [Apple iPhone Security Alert](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/apple-warns-iphone-users-software-223956485.html): Apple alerts iPhone users to iOS vulnerabilities and DarkSword exploit kits
- [Pam Bondi and Epstein Files](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/law-bondi-says-dems-storm-061908312.html): Pam Bondi and House Oversight Committee clash over Epstein files subpoena
- [Extreme Heat Wave Forecast](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/maps-show-forecast-extreme-heat-182522212.html): Extreme heat wave forecast for western US including Phoenix and California

## Criminal Justice & Legal Cases

- [Whitey Bulger Writings](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/newly-discovered-whitey-bulger-writings-211301838.html): Whitey Bulger manuscript may overturn FBI agent John Connolly's conviction
- [Miami Gang Rape Case](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/boys-accused-gang-rape-12-181129755.html): Miami juvenile defendants seek bail in gang rape case involving 12-year-old

- [World Happiness Report](https://news.yahoo.com/articles/nordic-nation-world-happiest-country-000134742.html): Finland ranks as world's happiest country for ninth consecutive year
